newsitem.title: USA: US Gulf jet steady as firmer diffs offset futures.
newsitem.headline: US Gulf jet steady as firmer diffs offset futures.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were little changed late Monday as a 0.75-cent firming in differentials offset a decline in December heating oil futures prices, traders said.

Gulf prompt 54-grade fuel was offered at 0.25 cent above the December print, while New York material firmed to 2.0 cents over. Trade was scant, however, with small deals moving valuations, traders said.
"With such poor liquidity, one or two 50,000-barrel deals can sway the market," one trader said, noting players were awaiting tomorrow's weekly API data.
